verdict.rationale: Testing against a sandbox is a fair question for a Git hosting service with an API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no first-party sandbox or test environment. The API guide notes that no vendor page documents a hosted test instance: try.gitea.io no longer resolves and demo.gitea.com is undocumented as a demo. The Swagger try-it feature runs against the live instance API, not an isolated sandbox. Spinning up a separate self-hosted instance would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
